findings.description: When ANSI stripping is triggered, the code calls `.strip()` on the result of `strip_ansi(text)`, which removes leading and trailing whitespace from the prompt. The title only says to strip ANSI codes.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a prompt like "Name: " or "Continue? [y/N]: " with a trailing space, or one with leading indentation, when the stream is not a tty or color is disabled, as in piped output or CliRunner. The trailing space separating the prompt from user input is dropped, so output shows "Name:value" and the prompt text changes between tty and non-tty runs. Existing tests and users that compare prompt output will see different text.
